title: Super Vote Rewards
description: Vote, earn rewards, collect relics, and unlock cosmetics through a configurable vote progression system.
body:
# Super Vote Rewards

SuperSMPVoteRewards is a vote rewards plugin built around long-term progression instead of handing players a few random items every time they vote.

Players earn rewards for supporting the server while working toward larger milestones, collectibles, relics, cosmetics, and seasonal rewards.

The goal is to make voting feel meaningful rather than something players do once and forget about.

## Features

### Vote Tracking

Track player votes across supported vote sites and reward them automatically.

Players can view their progress and available rewards through in-game commands.

---

### Progression Rewards

Instead of giving the same reward every time, the plugin supports milestone-based progression.

Examples:

* Daily rewards
* Weekly milestones
* Monthly milestones
* Vote streak rewards

---

### Relics & Collectibles

Reward players with collectible items and relics as they continue voting.

Perfect for servers that use long-term collection systems.

---

### Cosmetic Integration

Works alongside cosmetic systems to reward players with:

* Titles
* Trails
* Crate Keys
* Seasonal Cosmetics

without requiring changes to your cosmetics plugin.

---

### Administrative Tools

Includes commands for:

* Progress viewing
* Debugging
* Reloading
* Pending vote checks
* Testing rewards

making it easy to verify vote integrations are working correctly.

## Commands

### Player Commands

`/vote`

View voting links and progress.

### Admin Commands

`/voterewards`

Manage rewards, progress, debugging, and configuration.

## Designed For

* SMP Servers
* Community Servers
* Seasonal Servers
* Long-Term Progression Systems

The plugin focuses on rewarding consistent support while keeping rewards configurable and easy to manage.
